thread:
deploy-bot: kickoff: staged rollout started for model=inference-v3 -> 5% global (30m change window). release notes https://redwood.internal/releases/inference-v3-2026 :rocket:

katrina: saw a latency blip in eu-west-1 ~ +120ms p95 within first 2 mins. grabbing traces now. @mike can you check routing for eu? :rotating_light:

mike: on it — looking at LB health and the new kernel selection. small spike on nodes running batch-optimizer. sharing quick query:
```
# p95 latency by region
select p95_latency from metrics where region='eu-west-1' and model='inference-v3' and ts > now() - 5m
```

ben: if eu is unstable we should pause the percent increase and pin traffic back to inference-v2 for eu only. can we do region-scoped pin?

mike: yes. command available: `redwoodctl rollout pin --model inference-v2 --region eu-west-1`

sre-oncall: recommend pause and pin until we confirm kernel fallback patch. vote: :thumbsup: to pause.

katrina: agreed — pause global increase. deploy-bot, can you stop the ramp and keep current 5% global while we pin eu?

deploy-bot: ramp paused at 5%. executing region pin action for eu-west-1 now. ETA ~ 30s. log: `action=pin region=eu-west-1 to_model=inference-v2 by=deploy-bot`

mike: pin applied. eu now serving inference-v2. continuing trace analysis; initial hypothesis: nvf kernel selection mis-applied on a fraction of nodes.

ben: filing rollforward/rollback ticket and adding to release notes that eu will remain on inference-v2 until follow-up patch: https://redwood.internal/tickets/ROLL-3421

sre-oncall: once we have a rollback-plan + kernel flag change, we can re-run a micro-canary (eu only) at 1% then 5%. for now, hold global ramp.

katrina: okay — I'll update stakeholders in #product and add a short note in the release doc. thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: status: paused, pin confirmed, ticket ROLL-3421 linked. last_action_ts=1755001449
